title: fitc4 configuration
description: Paths are resolved relative to this file. Providers are still composed in code; there is no command-provider configuration yet.

version.description: Config format version. An unknown version is an error, not a silent default.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root, relative to this file. Every reported path is relative to it.

scanRoots.description: Repository-relative directories under architecture control. A missing, misspelled, or source-free root is an error rather than an empty pass.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig supplying compiler options (paths, baseUrl) for module resolution.
